subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should persistent multi-agent workspace context live in the Dashboard breadcrumb/topbar, or should it move to the no-breadcrumb app-shell direction proposed by the open maintainer draft?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but current main moved the implementation surface and a maintainer-authored draft proposes removing the same breadcrumb surface, so automation cannot choose the final UX contract.

options.title: Port focused breadcrumb after choosing the surface
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, carry the workspace context into the current app shell, and reconcile it with the intended header/topbar design.

options.title: Fold context into the app-shell redesign
options.body: Use the open app-shell direction as the canonical UI and require workspace certainty to appear in another persistent surface there.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged until maintainers settle whether breadcrumbs remain part of the Dashboard contract.

recommendation.title: Port focused breadcrumb after choosing the surface
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, carry the workspace context into the current app shell, and reconcile it with the intended header/topbar design.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the workspace rail feature that supplies the data source and are a practical owner for deciding how the current UI shell should expose it.
